verdict.rationale: Vanta's first-party questionnaire-automation page says it combs the knowledge base of security documentation and previous questionnaires to generate responses, and leaves the user to review, approve and submit. That covers the AI-drafted, human-reviewed workflow. The AI Agent page and the Customer Trust questionnaire-response endpoints add support. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that answers are grounded in live controls and test data rather than only documents and past questionnaires; any independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality.
